game.title: Sabi Words
game.tagline: Find the hidden words before the clock runs out.
game.howto.1: Swipe over the letters in a straight line, in any direction, to circle a hidden word. Words can run forwards or backwards.
game.howto.2: Prefer to tap? Tap the first letter, then tap the last letter. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to move and Enter or Space to mark the start and the end.
game.howto.3: Stuck? The lantern shows the first letter of a word and costs 10 coins. Coins are only for fun: you earn them by finishing puzzles. Press H for a hint.
game.howto.4: Beat the clock: with half the time left you get 3 stars, with a fifth left you get 2, and 1 star for finishing. If time runs out, the round is lost.
game.howto.5: Pick one of six word packs on the menu. The Daily Puzzle is the same for everybody today: your first try counts, and replays are practice. Press P to pause.
menu.dailyUsed: Today's puzzle is started. Replays are practice.
